facts.fact: Hespress reports that the Direction generale des impots launched in May 2026 the electronic platform "Taxation on Digital Services" for foreign providers of remote services, under decree 2.25.862 which sets how they register, declare their Moroccan turnover and pay VAT.

Decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025 requires non-resident suppliers of remote digital services to register on the tax administration's electronic platform, file VAT returns electronically each quarter and pay electronically, entering into force six months after publication.
